name: cinecircle
description: CineCircle: private, follow-based movie and TV recommendations

scripts.api:lint: uv --directory api run ruff check . && uv --directory api run ruff format --check .
scripts.api:test:integration: uv --directory api run pytest tests/integration -m integration
scripts.fake:load: uv --directory api run python -m cinecircle_analysis load
scripts.fake:wipe: uv --directory api run python -m cinecircle_analysis wipe
scripts.analysis:run: uv --directory api run --group analysis python -m cinecircle_analysis notebooks
scripts.check: npm run api:lint && npm run api:test && npm run web:lint && npm run web:typecheck && npm run web:test && npm run web:build
scripts.dev: npm run db:start && echo "Database is up. Now run 'npm run api:dev' and 'npm run web:dev' in two more terminals."
